verdict.rationale: The evidence shows 01 as a voice-driven assistant that runs code, browses the web, manages files and controls software when the user asks. Nothing documents setting up recurring or scheduled automations, triggers, or background tasks that run without the user prompting them. Background automation is a fair axis for an agent platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
